memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Insomnia with comorbid depressive symptoms.
Patient reports difficulty falling asleep, frequent awakenings, low mood, poor concentration. She is a vegetable vendor, non-smoker, denies alcohol. On exam: alert, well-groomed, no distress. Technique checked: no inhaler in use.
Plan: start melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS for insomnia; start sertraline 50 mg OD for depression. Order ISI, TSH, Hb, PHQ-9, B12. Review in 6 weeks.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: ISI 18 (moderate insomnia). TSH 2.1 mIU/L (0.5-5.0). Hb 12.8 g/dL (12.0-15.5). PHQ-9 12 (moderate depression). Vitamin B12 320 pg/mL (200-900).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Insomnia and depressive symptoms partially improved.
Patient reports sleep onset better, still 2-3 nocturnal awakenings, mood improved but occasional low energy. Non-smoker. No inhaler.
Plan: continue melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS, sertraline 100 mg OD. Add mirtazapine 15 mg HS for sleep maintenance. Review in 8 weeks.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: ISI 11 (mild insomnia). TSH 2.0 mIU/L. Hb 13.0 g/dL. PHQ-9 8 (mild depression). Vitamin B12 340 pg/mL.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Insomnia worsened, depressive symptoms stable.
Patient reports difficulty staying asleep, morning grogginess from trazodone, mood unchanged. Non-smoker.
Plan: stop trazodone, increase melatonin to 5 mg HS, continue sertraline 100 mg OD, mirtazapine 15 mg HS. Review in 4 weeks.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up appointment booked for 2025-11-05 at 10:30 AM with Dr Suresh Menon (D05).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Insomnia improved, depressive symptoms worsened.
Patient reports better sleep onset, fewer awakenings, but increased sadness, anhedonia, fatigue. Non-smoker.
Plan: stop sertraline due to lack of mood improvement, start escitalopram 10 mg OD. Continue melatonin 5 mg HS, mirtazapine 15 mg HS. Review in 6 weeks.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: ISI 9 (mild insomnia). TSH 2.2 mIU/L. Hb 12.9 g/dL. PHQ-9 10 (moderate depression). Vitamin B12 330 pg/mL.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Insomnia and depressive symptoms stable.
Patient reports sleep satisfactory, mood improved, energy better. Non-smoker.
Plan: continue melatonin 5 mg HS, mirtazapine 15 mg HS, escitalopram 10 mg OD. Consider tapering melatonin. Review in 3 months.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Insomnia worsened due to work stress, depressive symptoms stable.
Patient reports difficulty falling asleep, frequent awakenings, mood unchanged. Non-smoker.
Plan: increase melatonin to 5 mg HS, add trazodone 25 mg HS PRN for sleep. Continue escitalopram 10 mg OD, mirtazapine 15 mg HS. Review in 6 weeks.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
melatonin 5 mg HS
trazodone 25 mg HS PRN

memories.author: lab
memories.text: ISI 10 (mild insomnia). TSH 2.1 mIU/L. Hb 13.1 g/dL. PHQ-9 9 (mild depression). Vitamin B12 340 pg/mL.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Insomnia and depressive symptoms well controlled.
Patient reports restful sleep, stable mood, good energy. Non-smoker.
Plan: continue current regimen, review in 3 months.
